conventions.eta: diag(-1,1,1,1); jets A_mu = d_mu M raw contravariant; u = timelike unit eigenvector of M eta
conventions.K_T: 1/2 sum_mu eta^{mu mu} [tr(h A_mu h A_mu) - tr(eta A_mu eta A_mu)], h = eta + 2 (eta u)(eta u)^T
conventions.action: L = -4[(1-lambda) I1 + lambda I1_h] - c2 K_T - V4, c2 > 0
conventions.Legendre: I(omega) = A + B omega + C omega^2 -> H_I = C omega^2 - A; energy of the action = sum_k c_k (C_k omega^2 - A_k); H2 = the omega^2 coefficient of the energy = sum_k c_k C_k (the R2 formmap convention, c_I1 = -4)
conventions.K_T energy: E[-c2 K_T] = c2 (2 sum_i sum_j (A_i)_{0j}^2 + 2 omega^2 sum_j (a0)_{0j}^2) in the u-frame; K0 = 2 c2 sum_j (a0)_{0j}^2 = its H2 contribution (a constant)

term.name: K_T
term.definition: K_T = 1/2 sum_mu eta^{mu mu} [tr(h_cov A_mu h_cov A_mu) - tr(eta A_mu eta A_mu)], A_mu = d_mu M (raw contravariant entries), h_cov = eta + 2 (eta u)(eta u)^T, u = timelike unit eigenvector of M eta (u^T eta u = -1); u-frame: 2 sum_mu eta^{mu mu} sum_j (A_mu)_{0j}^2 (class C4, two derivatives, the time-row kinetic term)

2_family.finding_C_zero: the omega^2 coefficient of K_T VANISHES on the whole R4 boost-dressing family: the dressed clock a0 = Qb a0_unit Qb^T pulled back to the u-frame (u = Qb e0) is the block-diagonal rotation flow, no time row; so -c2 K_T adds NO omega^2 floor and no kinetic inertia there, only the static localizer c2 E_KT(amp, R) > 0

3_channels_lp.claim_constant: the omega^2 coefficient of K_T is jet-INDEPENDENT on every channel (Q_KT = 0 to machine precision) and equals -2 sum_j a0_0j a0_j0 in the u-frame: -2 sum_j a0_0j^2 <= 0 on every SYMMETRIC a0 (physical), +2 sum_j a0_0j^2 on the antisymmetric probes (clock_t, clock_tr, x_boost_k_probe, aud_clock_random_*: coms(gamma, M) is antisymmetric in its boost part)
3_channels_lp.c2_never_hurts_scope: every SYMMETRIC a0 channel (physical jets); the antisymmetric probes carry K0 < 0 by the sign flip and are listed separately
3_channels_lp.verdict: c2 K_T adds a jet-independent constant K0 >= 0 to the omega^2 energy coefficient (never hurts); it cannot make the indefinite lambda < 1/2 form PSD (fails at jet scale sqrt(c2 K0 / |min eig|)); lambda* = 0.500000 with or without c2: c2 does NOT replace lambda >= 1/2

4_hedgehog.statement: K_T = 0 and its omega^2 coefficient = 0 on every block-diagonal static field with its clock flow (uniform time row, u = e0): the hedgehog static energy, its Derrick balance, the 3-lepton census and the Coulomb anchors (all 3x3-sector measurements) are untouched by -c2 K_T for ANY c2, by construction
